metric_scope: Hidden entries only; known observations excluded.

bootstrap.unit: independent trajectory, retaining hidden entries and draws
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fitted models and saved ensembles; training-seed variation separate.
bootstrap.multiple_comparisons: Intervals are unadjusted across metrics, seeds, and validation attempts.

interval_definition: Empirical 5th and 95th percentiles, with linear interpolation; finite draws affect coverage.
linear_baseline: Deterministic linear interpolation has zero-width intervals; its coverage is not a probabilistic calibration benchmark.
validation_reuse: Repeated candidate selection on the same validation set induces selection optimism; the gate is not a held-out test claim.
scope: Separate transfer tasks; no validation gate recomputed or modified.

across_seed_descriptive.scope: Descriptive variation across paired training/dataset seeds; no pooled inference.
